trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الْاَمْرِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ التَّدْبِیْرِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الرَّاۗیِ الْمَسْمُوْعِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْقَاۗئِمُ الْمُنْتَظَرُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْخَلَفُ الصَّالِحُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اِمَامَ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SAAHE-BAL AMRE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SAAHE-BAT TAD-BEERE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SAAHE-BAR RA-AAA-YIL MASMOO-E’. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA AYYO-HAL QAAA-E-MUL MUNTA-ZARO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL KHALA-FUS SAALE-HO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA IMAAMAL MUTTA-QEENA.

trans.en: Peace be on you, O he who has been given authority (by Allah) to command. Peace be on you, O he who has been endowed with ability to set (everything) in order. Peace be on you, O he whose opinion is accepted as true. Peace be on you, O he who is preserving, therefore awaited. Peace be on you, O he who has is an apt and proper descendant (of the Holy Prophet). Peace be on you, O the guide leader of those who safeguard themselves against evil.
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par, ay saahebe amr. Salaam ho aap par, ay saahebe tadbeer. Salaam ho aap par, ay maalik us raah ke jo sooni jaati hai. Salaam ho aap par, ay Qaaem jis ka intezaar hai. Salaam ho aap par, ay farzande swaleh. Salaam ho aap par, ay muttaqiyo’n ke Imam.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اِمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَلِیَّ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَلِیْفَۃَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَضْعَۃَ اَكْبَادِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حُجَّۃَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا عَوْنَ الْمَظْلُوْمِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA IMAAMAL MUSLE-MEENA. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA WALIYYAL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA KHALEE-FATA RASOOLIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA BAZ-A’TA AKBAA-DIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA HUJJA-TAL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA A’W-NAL MAZLOO-MEENA.

trans.en: Peace be on you, O the guide leader of those who surrender themselves to the will of Allah. Peace be on you, O the friend of Allah. Peace be on you, O the successor of the Messenger of Allah. Peace be on you, O he who is the part and parcel of those who are known as the heart of Allah. Peace be on you, O decisive argument of Allah (unto mankind).
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par, ay musalmaano ke Imam. Salaam ho aap par, ay Khuda ke wali. Salaam ho aap par, ay Rasoole Khuda (s.a.w.a) ke ja-nasheen. Salaam ho aap par, ay Khuda ke jigaro’n ke tukde. Salaam ho aap par, ay Khuda ki hujjat.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا غَوْثَ الْمَلَهُوْفِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا قُطْبَ الْعَالَمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْغَیْثُ الدَّافِقُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْغَوْثُ اللَّاحِقُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا نُوْرَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اِمَامَ الْمَسِیْحِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا عَدِیْلَ الْخِضْرِ وَقَوِیْمَهٗ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْحَاضِرُ الْغَاۗئِبُ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA GHAW-SAL MALA-HOO-FEENA. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA QUTBAL AA’LAME. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL GHAI-SUD DAAFE-QO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL GHAW-SUL LAAHE-QO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA NOORAL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA IMAAMAL MASEE-HE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA A’DEE-LAL KHIZRE WA QAWEE-MAHU. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL IMAAMUL HAAZE-RUL GHAAA-E-BO.

trans.en: Peace be on you, O helper of those who have been unjustly treated. Peace be on you, O supporter of those who have been oppressed. Peace be on you, O the pivot and the axis of the universe. Peace be on you, O he who is like the clouds full of rain (of mercy). Peace be on you, O he who comes to help decisively. Peace be on you, O the light of Allah. Peace be on you, O he whom prophet Isa will follow. Peace be on you, O he who is like prophet Khizr in perpetuity.
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par, ay mazloomo ke madad-gaar. Salaam ho aap par, ay gham-zado’n ke faryaad-ras (madad-gaar). Salaam ho aap par, ay aalam ke markaz. Salaam ho aap par, ay misl barasne waale (karam ke) baadal. Salaam ho aap par, ay aakhri faryaad-ras. Salaam ho aap par, ay Khuda ke noor. Salaam ho aap par, ay Janabe Isa (a.s) ke peshwa. Salaam ho aap par, ay misl Janabe Khizr (a.s) ki hayaat.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْغَاۗئِبُ الْحَاضِرُ اَدْرِكْنِیْ فِیْ ضَمِیْعِ اُمُوْرِیْ فِیْ مَضِاۗئِقِ الْاُمُوْرِ وَشَدَاۗئِدِهَا اَعِنِّیْ وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَیَّ وَانْصُرْ نِیْ وَلَا تَنْصُرْ عَلَیَّ وَكُنْ لِیْ وَلَا تَكُنْ عَلَیَّ وَلَا تُفَارِقْنِیْ خَوْفَ ظَاهِرٍ بِحَقِّ وِلَایَتِكَ وَغَیْبَتِكَ وَشَهَادَتِكَ وَبِحَقِّ اٰبَاۗئِكَ الْمَعْصُوْمِیْنَ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَیْهِمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL GHAAA'e BUL HAAZE-RO ADRIK-NEE FEE ZAMEE-E’ O-MOO-REE FEE MAZE-AA'e QIL O-MOORE WA SHADA-AA'e DEHAA A-INNEE WA LAA TO-I’N A’LAIYYA WAN SORNEE WA LAA TANSUR A’LAIYYA WA KUN WA LAA TA-KUN A’LAIYYA WA LAA TO-FAARIQ-NEE KHAWFA ZAAHE-RIN BE-HAQQE WELAAYATE-KA WA GHAIBATE-KA WA SHAHAADATE-KA WA BE-HAQQE AABAAA'e KAL MA’SOOMEE-NA SALWAA-TUL LAAHE A’LAI-HIM AJMA-EE’NA.

trans.en: Peace be on you, O the guide leader who is present but not visible. Peace be on you, O he who is not visible but is present. Help me to come out successfully from my difficult affairs and face boldly their hardships. Help me. Do not let anyone or anything have an upper hand over me. Support me. Do not support that which is working against me. Let whatever is good for me happen. Do not let happen that which may harm me. Do not leave me when apparent fear lurks for the sake of your wilayah (authority), your presence in the invisible world, your witness, and for the sake of your infallible forefathers, blessings of Allah be on all of them.
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par, ay woh Imam jo haazir bhi hai aur ghaayab bhi. Salaam ho aap par, ay woh Imam jo ghaayab bhi hai aur haazir bhi. Meri madad farmaaye mere saare kaamo mein, jo tangh ho ya dushwaar meri madad farmaaye, mere khilaaf kisi ki madad na farmaana, mere khilaaf kisi dushman ki madad na karna, mere taraf-daar rahena aur mukhaalif na hona. Mujh se judah na hona. Aap ko apne haq'e wilaayat wa ghaibat wa shahadat ki qasam, aur aap ko apne Aaba’e Masoomeen ke haq ki qasam, Allah ka durood ho un sab hazraat par.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: Then pray for your needs reciting many salawat.
desc.rurdu: Phir ziyadah se ziyadah salawaat padhte huwe apni haajat talab kare.
desc.urdu: اب جتنا ہو سکے سلوات پڑھے اور پھر اپنی حاجت طلب کرے۔
